messages:
alex_c: Quick heads-up — kicking off onboarding for the new 'redwood-mini-7b' variant into the catalog. Need a quick sanity check on weights location, tokenizer quirk, and the canary/fallback plan before I open the rollout PR.

maria_g: Thanks. Where are the weights located? I can run the config validation and a small smoke inference.

alex_c: S3 path: `s3://rdw-models/mini-7b/v1/weights/` (sharded: `part-0000..part-0007`). Manifest: `s3://rdw-models/mini-7b/v1/manifest.json`.

sasha_ml: Heads-up — tokenizer uses a custom pre-tokenizer that splits urs/punct differently. Ran a quick tokenize on the sample prompt and got different offsets vs our canonical tokenizer. Example:```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizers/mini-7b.json')
print(tok.encode("Don't split here: U.S.A."))
```

jonathan_k: Can you paste the token ids output? We need to verify special token mapping (e.g.,  token).

sasha_ml: Output snippet: `[101, 4679, 16, 2013, 345, 102]` — it's mapping the newline sentinel differently. I think we need `tokenizer.special_tokens_map` updated in model.yaml.

alex_c: Good catch. I'll add a `tokenizer_overrides` section in the catalog entry. Proposed diff:```yaml
model_id: redwood/mini-7b
version: v1
weights:
  - uri: s3://rdw-models/mini-7b/v1/manifest.json
tokenizer:
  file: tokenizers/mini-7b.json
  special_tokens_map:
    eos_token: ""
    pad_token: "<pad>"
```

ellie_pm: For rollout sequencing: recommend EU region first (eu-west-1), then us-west-2. Canaries should be ~5% traffic for 24h, then 25% for 6h before full. Also need a fallback variant for cpu inference in case GPU pool is saturated.

maria_g: Validation checklist I ran: 1) manifest checksums OK 2) config keys present (`kv_cache`, `max_seq_len`, `quantization_profile`) 3) tokenizer mapping includes EOS 4) sample decode roundtrip matched 98.7% of expected outputs on unit prompts.

alex_c: Nice. For quantization: start with `q4_0` profile for dedicated GPUs, add `int8_cpu` fallback model_id: `redwood/mini-7b-int8-cpu`. We'll pin the hosted catalog entry to `version: v1` and add fallback variants list.

jonathan_k: I'll open the PR for model.yaml + rollout policy. Can someone review the canary policy section? Planned keys: `canary_percentage`, `duration`, `regions`, `fallback_variant`.

ellie_pm: lgtm. One operational ask: add a `graceful_degrade` route that switches to `mini-7b-int8-cpu` when latency p90 > 1200ms for > 5m. Also log the fallback reason to telemetry.

infra-bot: Canaries scheduled: will reserve capacity in eu-west-1 for 6h from deploy start. (reservation-id: rsv-9876)

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued. PR link: <https://git.internal/redwood/catalog/pull/812>. Triggering canary at 2026-02-14T08:00Z unless someone objects in next 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria_g: Quick note — tokenizer file version bump required (tokenizers/mini-7b.json -> tokenizers/mini-7b@v1.1.json). I'll attach the tagged file to the PR. :thumbsup:

sasha_ml: Also add a short eval promptset for punctuation-heavy inputs — we saw divergence there. I'll upload `evals/mini-7b/puncts.json`.

alex_c: Perfect. If no blockers I’ll merge PR after infra reservation confirmed. Thanks everyone.

ellie_pm: No blockers from PM. Please ping once canary reached 5% and after 24h with metrics.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-02-14T08:02Z. Canary shards: 2 GPUs in eu-west-1. Metrics channel: #canary-metrics.

alex_c: Closing loop — will post a short postmortem if we hit any regression, otherwise will follow the rollout checklist and promote to full after approvals.

jonathan_k: thx, keeping an eye on logs.
